item.description: A comprehensive analysis of inventory valuation under the Income-tax Act, 2025, covering Section 277, independent valuation under Section 268(5)(ii), ICDS compliance and reporting through Form 101 and Form 26.

item.title: Income Tax Forms 2026 and 1962: Old vs New
item.description: The Income-tax Rules, 2026 introduce a comprehensive overhaul of compliance by replacing legacy forms under the 1962 Rules with an expanded and updated set of forms.

item.title: Form No 1 of IT Rules 2026: Stock Exchange Monthly Compliance Statement
item.description: Form No. 1 is a mandatory monthly statement for stock exchanges reporting client code modifications under Rule 4 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026, replacing Form 3BB, with updated filing requirements, structure and timelines.

item.title: Form No 2 of IT Rules 2026: Zero Coupon Bond Approval Application
item.description: Form 2 under Rule 7 of the Income-tax Rules, 2025 is mandatory for infrastructure entities and PSUs to apply for Zero-Coupon Bond (ZCB) notification. Learn eligibility, filing process, timelines, key conditions, and tax benefits under Section 2(112) and Section 32(1)(d).
